newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Anhui Expressway seen listing 35 pct of fir.
newsitem.headline: China Anhui Expressway seen listing 35 pct of fir.

text.p: China toll roads operator Anhui Expressway Co Ltd is set to list 35 percent of the company in Hong Kong at between HK$1.59 and HK$1.92 per share, market sources said on Thursday.
The sources said Anhui is expected to offer 85 percent of the 493 million H-shares to international investors and 15 percent in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The stock will come to the market at a 31.4 percent discount to the appraised NAV (net asset value), which had been calculated at HK$2.55 per share, the sources said.
H-shares are shares of mainland Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong.
The market sources said the Hong Kong flotation was due to begin on October 31 and dealing was expected to start on November 13.
Crosby Capital Markets (Asia) Ltd and CEF Capital Ltd are the sponsors and lead underwriters of the issue, the sources said. Officials at both companies declined to comment.
Analysts' briefings have been scheduled in Hong Kong for early next week, the sources said.
Anhui Expressway owns, operates and develops toll roads in China's central Anhui Province. The company currently owns and operates the 134-kilometre Hening (Nefei-Nanjing) Expressway.

The market sources said the company intends to use the proceeds of the sale to buy the entire 30-km Tianchang section of Highway 205 in Anhui and instal a new computerised ticketing and monitoring system for the Hening Expressway and Highway 205.
After the offering, Anhui Expressway will be 65 percent owned by Anhui Expressway Holding Corp, the only toll road operator in Anhui, the report said.
Anhui Expressway Holding Corp owns and operates the Hefei-Chaonu-Wuhu Expressway and Heifei-Tongling Class Two highway.
